info.title: Notebook connector
info.description: Read access to a Notebook account, recovered from the web app's own traffic. Not an official API.

sessionToken.description: The token the web app receives when you sign in. Take it from your own signed-in session.

post.description: Not offered as a tool: the connector takes a token you already have instead of handling your password.

get.description: Return the account the token belongs to.
List notes, newest page first. Pass the previous response's next_cursor as cursor to get the next page; next_cursor is null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. The app uses 3; the server allows up to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque position from a previous response's next_cursor.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page. null when there are no more.

total.description: How many notes match, across all pages.

post.description: Changes data. Left out of the connector on purpose; add "x-mcp": true here to offer it.

get.description: Return one note, including its body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The note's numeric id, from listNotes.
